_comment: PERMANENTLY PROTECTED FILES — C2B Web Design.
Read by .claude/hooks/chunk-scope-guard.js on EVERY invocation. A path listed
here is DENIED to Edit/Write/NotebookEdit at all times, independent of any
chunk scope file. This list does not expire and is not opt-in.
WHY THIS FILE IS TRACKED AND live-work/chunk-scope.json IS NOT: live-work/ is
gitignored scratch, so nothing in it can be a permanent record. Protection that
depended on someone remembering to write a scope file at the start of every
chunk was a remembered step — the exact failure mode this project removes.
This file is committed and reviewable; changing it shows up in a diff.
THE ONLY WAY PAST A LOCK: Carl names the specific file, and it is added to
"unlocked" in project-intelligence/live-work/chunk-scope.json for that chunk.
NEVER a folder, never a glob — the unlock is per file, by name, every time.
PATHS ONLY. No globs, no trailing-slash folder prefixes. A folder pattern would
lock files nobody has reviewed and would grow silently as the folder grows.
Repo-root-relative, forward slashes.
⚠ IF THIS FILE IS MISSING, UNREADABLE OR MALFORMED THE HOOK DENIES EVERY EDIT.
That is deliberate. A silent allow is what this file exists to remove.
⚠ THIS LIST NOW PROTECTS ITSELF — ON THE ORDINARY EDIT PATH ONLY.
'.claude/protected-files.json' is listed in its own "protected" array, so
Edit/Write/NotebookEdit against it is DENIED like any other locked file. An
unlock naming this exact file is the only way to change it through that path.
Removing an entry to reach the file it defended is no longer a legal edit,
because removing it requires editing this file, which is itself denied.
⚠ BUT THE HOOK RUNS ON Edit/Write/NotebookEdit AND NOTHING ELSE. Bash writes
by redirect, sed -i, mv, cp and rm never reach it, so this file — and every
path it lists — can still be rewritten or deleted from a shell. The
self-protection closes the ordinary edit path, not the shell. What catches a
shell write is the diff, because this file is tracked: a reviewer, not a
mechanism. Do not read the lock as tamper-proofing.
⚠ EDITING THIS FILE LEGITIMATELY: ask Carl to name it, add
'.claude/protected-files.json' to "unlocked" in live-work/chunk-scope.json,
make the change, then remove the unlock. Adding a NEW path to the list is
itself a change to this file and needs that same unlock.
